text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list known as the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, simple descriptions of what a user needs. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and solve problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to improve their product step by step and respond quickly to changes.
